name: Blazing Call
summary: The tutorial's Static: every arrival tidies the top of the deck, two arrivals draw.

face.name: Blazing Call

effect.name: Effect
effect.text: Each time a Human Entity enters your Front, look at the top card of your deck: you may put it on the bottom of your deck. If instead at least 2 Human Entities entered your Front this turn, draw a card.

face.flavor: The more they are, the higher it burns.
